trial_court: Court of Shri Sanjeev Kumar Singh : Administrative Civil Judge (Central) : Delhi - Petition No.: 696/2005
case_name: Smt. Sushila Devi @ Sheela vs The State & Others

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Sushila Devi @ Sheela, Baby Sohan (widow and daughter of deceased)

facts_of_case: Petitioners filed a succession petition for grant of succession certificate in their favour qua the debts and securities of deceased Sh. Raj Prasad.

legal_principles.principle: A child born out of a void marriage is illegitimate.
legal_principles.held: Petitioner No. 2 can at best be termed as illegitimate children.
cited_cases: Smt. Sushila Devi @ Sheela vs The State & Others, (2010)

legal_principles.principle: A child born out of a voidable marriage is deemed to be the legitimate child of the parties if at the date of the decree it had been dissolved instead of being annulled.
legal_principles.held: Any child begotten or conceived before the decree is made, who would have been the legitimate child of the parties to the marriage if at the date of the decree it had been dissolved instead of being annulled, shall be deemed to be their legitimate child notwithstanding the decree of nullity.
cited_cases: Smt. Parayankandiyal Eravath Kanapravan Kalliani Amma and olthers, Appellants v. K. Devi and others, Respondents, AIR 1996 SUPREME COURT 1963=1996 AIR SCW 2337

outcome.final_order: The court granted the succession certificate to the petitioners.
